items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Jack McVea had made a record on the coast and it was caught on fire and so we had to record this right quick. And that's how I did that with him.

ctx.x: One of the things I wanted to get into, of course, was your recording history. And with both, I think, of your earliest recordings, I think, were both...actually featured vocalists, 'Open the Door Richard' and 'St. James Infirmary'.

Well 'Open the Door Richard' was a comedian, Dusty Fletcher, you see. And how that happened, Jack McVea had made a record on the coast and it was caught on fire and so we had to record this right quick. And that's how I did that with him. Then I did a week in the Baby Grand
with Joe Turner and then I made some recordings with Sarah Vaughan.
